composition.name: ANTIBODY REACTOR
composition.engineer: Kenneth E. Sweet Jr., composing owned SHPBL/CMPSBL capability bodies with agent-assisted implementation under his approval authority
composition.approval: Explicit human approval to materialize SEM-OASB-001

source_library.note: Identified for provenance only. No source, capability body or library archive from the private SHPBL/CMPSBL library is included in this repository; the parents manifest carries unit names and seals, not code.

release.license_note: Relicensed from LicenseRef-CMPSBL-Perpetual-1.0 to MIT by the rights holder for public adoption. The MIT grant covers this repository only and does not extend to the private SHPBL/CMPSBL capability library or to the OASB corpus, neither of which is distributed here.
release.audit: Independent adversarial re-audit of v0.1.1 with remediation. Fixes were selected so they could not perturb the evolutionary trajectory; verified by comparing the rebuilt artifacts against the v0.1.1 artifacts. Champion, sealed-holdout recall and five-fold out-of-fold recall are unchanged.

reproducibility.method: All artifact-bound timestamps come from a fixed-epoch logical clock (src/clock.ts). Two runs of the same seed against the same corpus bytes produce byte-identical artifacts.

claim_boundaries: The defensible external detection receipt is out-of-fold categorized-attack recall: 220/270 = 81.48% across five independent evolutionary populations, each OASB categorized fixture held out exactly once.
Sealed-holdout recall of 29/34 = 85.29% is secondary evidence over a small denominator and must not be compared directly to a scanner measured over all 270 fixtures.

OASB withdrew its precision, F1, false-positive-rate and flag-rate claims on 2026-08-09 because much of the benign class was labeled using the scanner under test. Benign disagreement here (49/3,975 out-of-fold, 1.23%; 1/608 on the sealed holdout, 0.16%) is retained as evolutionary counter-pressure and is not a false-positive-rate claim.
OASB is used as evolutionary selection pressure. Results are not presented as an independent post-hoc benchmark score, and no comparability to OASB or HackMyAgent historical scores is claimed.
No OASB sample id, expected answer, benchmark filename or fixture identity is hard-coded. Classification depends only on artifact content and the evolved genome.
